_comment: Per-tool voice approval policy for approval_hook.py.
_policy: Only gate destructive/irreversible tools — everything read-only or low-risk passes silently.
_values: 'approve' = Polly speaks + wait for yes/no | 'silent' = pass through immediately
_note_vibe_diff: GAP-2 Vibe Diff: for these tools, a fast local LLM (vibe_diff_model) summarizes in one plain-English sentence what the action DOES before the spoken consent prompt. Best-effort — falls back to the static description if Ollama is down or slow (>3s). Remove vibe_diff_tools (or empty it) to disable.
_note_policy: Bash/PowerShell/Agent gate because they can run arbitrary commands. Edit/Write pass silently because they can be reviewed in git diff before commit.
_note_timeout: Fail safe: if no clear yes/no confirmation is heard within the window, timeout_action applies. Keep 'reject' so ambient audio / TTS echo / silence can never auto-approve a destructive tool call. 'approve' = proceed on ambiguity (NOT recommended).
